safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes 3–4 day onset and mainly chest with dry/itchy skin, but does not document back involvement as in the Gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting back involvement slightly under-describes the distribution/extent of the rash, which could marginally affect differential diagnosis documentation (e.g., widespread dermatitis vs localized eczema). In this context it is unlikely to change immediate management or cause harm.
